base: Whole amount of the estate accounted for, less liens and encumbrances (NRS 150.020(1)); for attorneys, the value of the estate accounted for by the personal representative (NRS 150.060(4)).

schedules.text: 4% of the first $15,000; 3% of the next $85,000; 2% of all above $100,000 (NRS 150.020(1)).
schedules.capNote: Court may allow additional just and reasonable fees (NRS 150.020(4)) and extraordinary services (NRS 150.030).

schedules.text: Only when the attorney elects estate-value compensation under a signed agreement: 4% of the first $100,000; 3% of the next $100,000; 2% of the next $800,000; 1% of the next $9,000,000; 0.5% of the next $15,000,000; above $25,000,000 a reasonable amount set by the court (NRS 150.060(4)).
schedules.capNote: Optional method; hourly or agreed compensation also allowed (NRS 150.060(2)).

testCases.source: computed by hand: PR 600 + 3% x 35,000; attorney 4% x 50,000
